reactor_type: traveling-wave type ALD reactor (Lucida-D100, NCD Technology, Korea)
evidence: The Ru films were deposited using a traveling-wave type ALD reactor (Lucida-D100, NCD Technology, Korea) with a new beta-diketonate Ru precursor, dicarbonyl-bis(5-methyl-2,4-hexanediketonato) Ru(II) (C16H22O6Ru), at a substrate temperature of 250 /C14 C. The precursor is a yellow liquid at room temperature with a vapor pressure of 0.5 Torr at 100 /C14 C. The working pressure was varied from 10 to 300 Torr to obtain high quality Ru films. The working pressure was controlled with a throttle valve and was kept constant throughout the film deposition.
